title: CUBE Satellite workshop 2.0 DAY 04
summary: The DAY 04 webinar session of the Cube Satellite and Ground Station Control Workshop CUBESAT 2.0 organized by IEEE Microwave Theory and Techniques Society Student Branch Chapter of University of Peradeniya and SEDS Chapter of University of Peradeniya in collaboration with Orion Space pvt ltd Nepal was held successfu…
descriptionHtml:
The DAY 04 webinar session of the Cube Satellite and Ground Station Control Workshop CUBESAT 2.0 organized by IEEE Microwave Theory and Techniques Society Student Branch Chapter of University of Peradeniya and SEDS Chapter of University of Peradeniya in collaboration with Orion Space pvt ltd Nepal was held successfully on the 6th June 2021 via Zoom platform with the participation of enthusiastic participants from all over the country. 

 

The session was conducted by Mr. Jithen Thapa, Research and Development Engineer at Orion Space. Structural subsystems and Electrical power subsystems were taken into discussion and the discussion was followed by a Q and A session in order to give the participants to ask questions and get clarifications to their doubts. 

At the end of the session an online quiz was taken place to give the participants an idea on what they acquired from the session. 

 

This was another milestone of the CUBESAT 2.0 workshop series which was organized with the main goal of promoting satellite technology and space education in the country. 

The session ended successfully with the hope of connecting the following week to explore more areas of the topic.
